file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored movements_list view function to use apply_list_filters utility instead of manual filter implementation
key_modifications: Replaced manual filter extraction from request.GET with FilterConfig objects
Replaced manual Q() query filtering with centralized apply_list_filters utility
Integrated apply_date_range_filter for date range handling
Simplified pagination by delegating to apply_list_filters
Updated context data structure to use result dictionary from apply_list_filters

patterns_discovered.description: Replacing repetitive manual filter logic with reusable FilterConfig-based utility functions
patterns_discovered.implementation_details: FilterConfig objects declare filter type (search, field), parameter names, and filter conditions declaratively
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication, improves maintainability, centralizes filter logic

patterns_discovered.description: Separating date range filtering from general filters, applied sequentially
patterns_discovered.implementation_details: apply_date_range_filter applied first with direct return of date values, then apply_list_filters for remaining filters
patterns_discovered.benefit: Maintains special handling for date ranges while standardizing other filter types

patterns_discovered.description: Filter utilities returning structured dictionaries containing both filtered queryset and filter values
patterns_discovered.implementation_details: Result includes 'queryset', 'filter_values', and pagination data in single dictionary
patterns_discovered.benefit: Single return point with all necessary data for template context construction

gotchas_discovered.description: Date values from apply_date_range_filter must be extracted separately from FilterConfig-based filters
gotchas_discovered.impact: Context construction requires accessing both result['filter_values'] and date_values separately
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Use apply_date_range_filter's return value (date_values) in context alongside result dictionary

gotchas_discovered.description: FilterConfig param_name must match request.GET parameter names while filter_kwargs may use different field names
gotchas_discovered.impact: Warehouse filter uses param_name='warehouse' but filter_kwargs uses 'warehouse_id': '{value}'
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Carefully map request parameters to database field names in FilterConfig filter_kwargs

gotchas_discovered.description: Refactoring changed how context variables are populated (direct vs from result dictionary)
gotchas_discovered.impact: Templates expecting certain variable formats may require updates
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Maintain backward compatibility by mapping result dictionary values to original context variable names

approach_outcome.completion_notes: Successfully refactored movements_list view to use apply_list_filters utility, reducing manual filter code by 35 lines while maintaining functionality. Integrated both apply_list_filters and apply_date_range_filter utilities for comprehensive filtering.

code_quality_metrics.lines_reduction: 35 lines removed, 19 lines added (net -16 lines, 30% reduction)
code_quality_metrics.abstraction_improvement: Moved from manual filter logic to declarative FilterConfig approach

recommendations.recommendation: Add unit tests for movements_list with various filter combinations to ensure apply_list_filters integration works correctly with all filter types (search, field, date range)
Document the pattern of using apply_date_range_filter separately before apply_list_filters when date ranges need special handling
Verify that the inventory/movements_list.html template correctly handles the refactored context variable structure (result['filter_values'] vs direct variables)
Apply this same refactoring pattern to other list views in the codebase that use similar manual filtering logic for consistency
Monitor performance of apply_list_filters with complex filter combinations to ensure it maintains database query efficiency
